# Cloud session listing fixtures

These files are the cloud session listings `test_adopt_original_session.py` passes with `--cloud-sessions-file`. The row shape (`id`, `title`, `session_status`, `created_at`, `updated_at`, `environment_kind`, `status_bucket`, and the page's `has_more`, `first_id`, `last_id`) and the `{"ccr": {...}}` wrapper of a `get_session` result were recorded from the host's own `list_sessions` and `get_session` calls on 2026-10-24, trimmed to those keys: `list_page_more.json`, `list_page_complete_without.json`, `get_session_unrelated.json` (the unrelated session `session_01EayHcxxpijEm9tM6zQzVqu` is the recorded row), and the running rows of `list_page_complete_running.json` and `get_session_running.json`, whose id and title are the fixture lane's (`session_01FixtureLane0000000000`, `issue-656-fixturelane000001`) and whose `REVIEW_READY` bucket is the handed-back field case. `list_page_complete_archived.json` and `list_page_complete_failed.json` are synthetic: no archived or failed row was observed, so they carry the recorded row shape with `session_status` set to `SESSION_STATUS_ARCHIVED` and `status_bucket` set to `SESSION_STATUS_BUCKET_FAILED`, which are the host's spelling inferred from the running values.
